notes: Premade voices on this account are not verified for eleven_v4 and expire on 31 December 2026, so only library voices verified for v4 are candidates. eleven_v4 takes stability and similarity only (no speed or style). Audition: one take of the first line per candidate; the chosen voice's audition take counts as take 1 of that line.

v4.note: audition: speech too fast for the targets (0.70-0.74 s for 'Hello again.')

v4calm.note: speech 1.60 s for 'Hello again.' (too slow) and darker, softer (centroid 238 Hz, peak -6 dBFS)

v2s85.note: speech 0.80 s for 'Hello again.' (just under 0.9 s); pitch range 5.5 semitones

v4c.note: speech 0.83 s (short) and darker, softer (centroid 269 Hz); character alignment is uniform (48 ms per character), not real

v2s75.note: 'Hello again.' 0.87-0.92 s depending on the threshold (-30 to -50 dB): on the 0.9 s minimum, so too fragile

v2s70.note: the model's slowest speed, for a margin above the minimum lengths

chosen.why: eleven_v4 has no speed control: plain v4 speaks 'Hello again.' in 0.74 s (target 0.9-1.4 s); delivery tags change the timbre (darker, softer) and pace unpredictably (0.83-1.60 s), and v4's character times are uniform estimates. The steady fallback eleven_multilingual_v2 (stability 0.7, similarity 0.75, style 0) at speed 0.70 or 0.75 meets the targets with an even pitch and real alignment; per line the take is chosen from both speeds by scripts/audio/voice_finalize.py.
